batch_notes: Read the complete pilot-a input stream in consecutive 16,000-character chunks from offset 0 to 272000, then the final 15,696 characters through offset 287696; all body rows, parts and notes were inspected, including the complete industrial-products record. No OCR or Git operations were used.

Date-only rosters are textual; the bank directory, concession-area lists, subscriber list and military-service-duration table remain statistical because their substantive columns contain amounts, areas, counts or durations.

Classification follows body subjects without inherited collection geography or chapter labels. The multi-industry industrial-products table uses industrial-output rather than selecting incidental commodities. Financial and business summaries necessarily retain only their most useful detailed labels under the three-tag limit.

Two targeted review cases remain: sporting participation lacks an exact approved detailed tag, and the railway settlement inventory does not itself specify foreign sponsorship/nationality needed to confirm settler-migration.
